headline: CHW @ PHI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHW 3.73 at PHI 4.50, with a projected total of 8.22. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (CHW +0.93, PHI +0.97), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +1.90, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -13.0%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Tyler Gilbert has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.0 ER over the last 2 outings. Batter research is strongest for Chase Meidroth, Brandon Marsh, Jacob Gonzalez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Rafael Marchán because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
